# Fire and Life Safety Brief

**Document:** PSD-FLS-001
**Revision:** 1
**Status:** Issued for proposal

The design objective is to limit smoke spread, maintain tenable egress, and
support emergency operations. The final Code path depends on confirmation of
occupancy classification, containment geometry, and the authority's treatment
of the secure operations areas. Those predicates are not all established in
this brief.

Where a fire alarm system is installed, provide detection and staff
notification appropriate to the confirmed room uses. Air-handling systems
serving more than one smoke compartment shall be coordinated with damper,
shutdown, and control requirements. Do not infer that this brief alone proves
that a dedicated engineered smoke-control system is required throughout the
facility.

The secure operations floor is shown as a controlled area. Its final
classification and any alternative compliance path require confirmation before
the smoke strategy is closed.

The stair pressurization package is a clean control: the issued stair detail
states the target pressure range, door-opening force limit, relief path, and
commissioning test responsibility. It is delegated for equipment selection
but its proposal-stage performance and verification scope are bounded.
